headline.text: Three small resale gaps look open this week; about $60 a month if you act on one a week.

items.title: Used monitor, local listing
items.detail: Listed about $45 under the usual sold price. Needs pickup and a quick test.

items.title: Gift-card discount

items.detail: Small margin, low effort, fast to sell.
